gri_path: GRI 1: heading 6202 women's overcoats, carcoats and similar woven coats (assumed woven; knit would be 6102)
GRI 6: 6202.40 of man-made fibers (polyester predominates by weight over wool, Section XI note 2)

rejected_alternatives.reason: applies if knit or crocheted; construction not stated

classification.rationale: A women's knee-length coat of 70/30 polyester/wool, assumed woven, falls in 6202; polyester is the predominant fiber so the man-made fiber subheading applies. H81643 (woven wool/acrylic women's coat, 6202.11) supports heading 6202 for women's woven coats but differs on fiber.
